Sam (AE): Heads-up: Asterion Systems CISO paused our POC. They require BYO-KMS attestation + a clear start date (they want next Monday). Can we realistically commit? @Lina @Gus
Lina (Solutions): Quick read: Dedicated pool can go live in 72hrs, but BYO-KMS attestation and key handoff is the slow part (~7-10 business days). They also want IP allowlist and an ops contact for peering.
Gus (Eng-Infra): Connector work (lightweight agent + secure tunnel) estimated 6-8bd including hardening. BYO-KMS HSM handshake testing adds ~2bd. If they accept managed-KMS for demo, we can hit Monday otherwise likely two weeks.
Maya (Legal): I'll draft BYO-KMS contract clause and an attestation addendum. Can someone send the CISO questionnaire? We need specifics to map evidence.
ops-bot: Note: egress peering requires ASN + authorized IPs. Ops owner assigned: Jordan.
sec-bot: Reminder: provide audit log retention detail and encryption-in-transit notes for the questionnaire.
Sam (AE): Customer said they need a named demo SLA: p95 < 600ms for chat. They also want a swap plan to BYO-KMS mid-pilot with a hard swap date.
Lina (Solutions): Proposal: Phase 1 (fast): Dedicated + managed-KMS + IP allowlist + audit logs — demo in 3bd. Phase 2 (final): Private + BYO-KMS swap within 10bd. Pros/cons and cost delta in one-pager.
Gus (Eng-Infra): I'll validate connector ETA and post a short runbook snippet for fallback config:
```
model: rwd-infer-small-int8
batch_size: 8
latency_target_ms: 600
```
Sam (AE): Action list: 1) Lina one-pager (costs + swap plan) before noon, 2) Gus connector ETA + runbook by 2pm, 3) Maya BYO-KMS clause draft EOD. Scheduling 20m exec sync at 3pm PT.
Maya (Legal): Acknowledged. I'll include evidence links (SOC2 summary, encryption spec) in the draft.
Sam (AE): If ops can accept temporary managed-KMS concession with a guaranteed swap date, we might keep them in the pipeline. Please keep updates in-thread only. :lock:
